notes.title: Demo update v0.4.11
notes.content:
Hello exorcists! This new patch brings a few QoL changes. The main one being the candle minigame.

Prior to version 0.4.11, if you moved the candle too fast it would go out, you would then have to hold it still and press Q/RMB until it was lit again. This was a bit confusing and it was also making the candle minigame more complex than the other relics.

In this version the candle won't go out anymore. If you move too fast, the candle will start flickering and you won't be able to find the symbol (nor use the distance hint). You have to slow down until the flickering stops.

Some other changes include:

World Map: Double clicking a village will highlight the travel button.

Helper for new players trying to understand how the map works.

The Concilium now appears as a single entity in the abbey, instead of the 3 members individually.

Remove horse SFX when you arrive at a location. It was hard to hear on top of the map SFX and some players were mistaking it for a demonic sound.

Fix typos and layout in the prophecy cutscene.

All these changes were implemented based on player experience. If you have any feedback don't hesitate to reach out, it helps us a lot!

See you next time!

notes.title: Demo update v0.4.10
notes.content:
Hello exorcists! Update 0.4.10 brings a few changes aimed at speeding up the early game, allowing you to get to real exorcisms as soon as possible:

Increase movement speed by 30%.

Add option to skip training exorcism.

Not recommended if it is your first time playing! But if you think you got the gist of it you can hold Q to stop the training in the middle of the exorcism.

Show exorcism input hints until you exorcise a demon.

Just a helping hand, especially for those that skipped the training exorcism.

Remove F1 key bind from tutorial popup. H is the only key that opens the tutorial.

No reason for having 2 keys assigned to that action. H can be used on keyboards without function keys.

We hope these changes help in getting players to the core loop faster. If you have any feedback feel free to reach out!

See you next time!

notes.title: Demo update v0.4.9
notes.content:
Version 0.4.9 brings a few small QoL updates and fixes:

Training

Reduce the amount of rounds in training minigames.

Let players see Honey and Crosses tooltips during training dialogue.

Exorcism

Possession will increase faster.

Reduce number of minigames required to 4, making it less repetitive.

Completing a minigame reduces possession by 10% instead of 15%.

Better highlight of empty slots in St. Benedict's medal minigame.

UI - Fix issue with player marker appearing on top of tooltips on the world map.

Make tutorial popups keyboard navigation consistent with other screens (close with Esc).

If you tried the demo we would love to hear your feedback!

See you on the next update!

notes.title: Hello from the Tusks And Talons team!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We would like to take this opportunity to introduce ourselves. We are Lady Boar and Indie Talons, the two members of Tusks And Talons Games.

As a small team we wear many hats, but our main roles are:

 Lady Boar - Art and UI.
 Indie Talons - Programming and sound design.

Game design, narrative and everything else is a shared effort. 

As of now we are self funded and self published, working full time on Blood Of The Lamb, our debut title. We are currently preparing a demo that will be released in the coming months.

If you want to know more about how the game is being developed, you can follow us on our social media pages. We try to post updates of what we're currently working on.

@LadyBoar on Bluesky
@IndieTalons on Bluesky
@IndieTalons on X

Nice to meet you all, see you on the next one!
- Lady Boar and Indie Talons
